items.text: What happened to the criminal?
Why do they want his family's help?
Now here are the rest of today's top stories.
The volcano created a disaster thousands of miles away, didn't it?
We'll go there sometime next week, won't we?
When will(shall) we have a live report?
In fact many of them are from Los Angeles, aren't they?
It is high noon in Los Angeles, isn't it?
Welcome back to Korea.
They are probably up.
You had a toothache yesterday, didn't you?
Has it stopped aching now?
The tooth is aching now.
What's in them?
They are cooperating with the agency.
The Defense Department wouldn't comment any further than that.
That could reduce the fear of suspects.
They have to(must) deal with the disaster.
Which(what) company makes chewing tobacco?
How did the government boost its sale?
The company isn't running the ads, is it?
Oral tobacco carries its own health risks, doesn't it?
My husband is winning, isn't he?
Look at that!
I totally won the bet.
Olympia is taking the Pepsi challenge.
Why is the fast food chain switching its soft drink?
Who offered a better deal?
All 1900 Olympia outlets will be serving it within 60 days, won't they?
Coca Cola also is based in Atlanta, isn't it?
Didn't it try to get a temporary restraining order?
Why is the judge refusing to stop the switch?
It will seek arbitration, won't it?
How long will it take?
When am I going to(shall I, will I) meet your friends and your brothers?
You can't attend the party because you have a previous engagement, can you?
Did you get(reach) there on time?
Didn't you drop your handkerchief?
